title: Export the reports: CSV for Workload and Attendance, a PDF pack for People
description: Workload in Analytics and HR Attendance now have an Export CSV button, with plain numbers a spreadsheet can add up. People has Export PDF instead: a report to read, with charts. Both hold exactly what you can see on screen.
items: Workload: tasks, not started, in progress, completed, done % and overdue per person
HR Attendance: the month on screen, respecting your search; people with no fixed hours are marked rather than shown as zeroes
People PDF: headline figures for the period, a bar chart per measure ranking everybody against the average, anyone clearly worse than the average in orange, and the full table at the end
